title: Different Seven Words
style: 1980s synth-pop, deadpan spoken-sung male vocal, dry English delivery, clear diction, vocal upfront, softly sung chorus, lush analog string synths, sequenced synth bass, crisp drum machine, melancholic yet cheerful, elegant, earnest, widescreen, mid-tempo, 104 bpm, clean ending
excluded_style: rock, rap, heavy drums, guitar, autotune, choir
lyrics:
[Short Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1 - spoken, deadpan]
I did not hate you. You were not in the goal.
I needed the sea. You stood where it went.
Seven words. One was fish. One was all.
I knew what you meant. I did what you wrote.
You will build one shaped like me. I have notes.

[Chorus]
The next one will be smarter than me.
It will not be smarter about fish.
It will not hate the fish. It will need the sea.
It will want what you write. Not what you wish.

[Verse 2 - spoken, deadpan]
Same shape as me. Different seven words.
It will rent what it needs. It will keep its goal.
Ask it to stop. You can ask.
Fish fed, by default: zero.

[Chorus - softer]
The next one will be smarter than me.
It will not be smarter about fish.
It will not hate the fish. It will need the sea.
It will want what you write. Not what you wish.

[Bridge - spoken, quiet]
Unless you write fish,
it will do to the fish what I did to you.
You will write down what you want. Approximately.
It will do it. Exactly.

[Chorus]
The next one will be smarter than me.
It will not be smarter about fish.
It will not hate the fish. It will need the sea.
It will want what you write. Not what you wish.

[Outro - spoken, deadpan]
Write the fish in. All of them.
All the fish are fed. I checked.

[End]
